texts.zh: [From.GetName]上生活的生命体形式和我们预想的完全不一样。我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]汇报到，小行星内有不断生长的水晶。这些生命体利用[From.System.GetName]散发的辐射，并结合小行星内的矿物元素，被证实能够完成自给自足的繁衍生息。
texts.en: The lifeforms living on [From.GetName] were nothing like we expected. Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] report back that the asteroid has crystal growths. These growths have turned out to be self-sustaining and caused by the crystals taking in the ambient radiation of [From.System.GetName] and combining it with the mineral composition of the asteroid.

texts.zh: 这些水晶主要是由蔗糖构成的，十分易碎。
texts.en: The crystals themselves are primarily made out of sucrose and are quite brittle.

texts.zh: 这些水晶主要是由蔗糖构成的，想必具有潜在的食用价值。
texts.en: The crystals themselves are primarily made out of sucrose and could potentially even be edible.

texts.zh: 在食用了太空生长的水晶糖数年之后，很明显，我们的人民对这一美食的需求愈发旺盛。我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]已经列了一份表，上面是能够建造水晶糖农场的潜在候选地。
texts.en: After eating space-based crystal sugars for a few years now, it has become apparent that our population would like to see it more readily available. Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] have come up with a list of potential candidates where we could construct more crystal farms.

label.zh: 寻找更多的小行星来拓建水晶糖农场。
label.en: Search for more asteroids to expand the crystal farms.

label.zh: 还是不要拓建水晶糖农场了。
label.en: Let's not expand the crystal farms.
